scope: All 30 source problems; exempt from the five-per-subtype limit. Reviewed does not mean implemented. Use independently checked answers and concise adapted wording.

items.label: Barrier detour
items.authoringNote: Define when the barrier becomes observable before optimising the route.

items.label: Cargo optimisation
items.authoringNote: State divisible cargo and volume assumptions.

items.label: Unbounded lottery
items.authoringNote: Personal willingness to pay has no unique correct value; distinguish it from expected payout.

items.label: Birthday deduction
items.authoringNote: Correct the swapped month/day information assignments before authoring.

items.label: Three-digit expressions
items.authoringNote: Define permitted operations and how symbols are counted; verify feasibility for every digit.

items.label: Unreliable witnesses
items.authoringNote: State independence and the prior probability.

items.label: Prisoner signalling
items.authoringNote: Check the strategy against both unknown initial switch states.

items.label: Uneven ropes
items.authoringNote: Distinguish a measured interval from elapsed time since lighting.

items.label: Aircraft refuelling
items.authoringNote: Verify a complete schedule with every aircraft returning.

items.label: Coprime wager
items.authoringNote: Specify the sampling range and distribution.

items.label: Birth proportions
items.authoringNote: Distinguish limiting population proportions from an expected finite ratio.

items.label: Pirate allocation
items.authoringNote: State tie-breaking preferences as well as the voting threshold.
